<script type="text/javascript">

var substringMatcher = function(strs) {
	  return function findMatches(q, cb) {
	    var matches, substringRegex;

	    // an array that will be populated with substring matches
	    matches = [];

	    // regex used to determine if a string contains the substring `q`
	    substrRegex = new RegExp(q, 'i');

	    // iterate through the pool of strings and for any string that
	    // contains the substring `q`, add it to the `matches` array
	    $.each(strs, function(i, str) {
	      if (substrRegex.test(str)) {
	        matches.push(str);
	      }
	    });

	    cb(matches);
	  };
	};

$(document).ready(function(){

    var cars=arrTrainList;
 
    // Initializing the typeahead
    $('#trainNo').typeahead({
        hint: false,
        maxItem: 10,
        displayKey: 'value',
        highlight: true, 
        minLength: 1 
    },
    {
        name: 'cars',
        source:substringMatcher(cars),
        limit: 15,
        templates: {
            empty: [
                '<div class="empty-message">',
                  'No data',
                '</div>'
              ].join('\n'),
              suggestion: function(data) {
                return '<p><strong>'+data+'</strong></p>';
              }
          }
    }).on('typeahead:selected', function(event, selection) {
  	  
  	  // the second argument has the info you want

<script>
function toggleNonStopsXX(cls) {

  var rows = document.getElementsByClassName(cls);
  var isOpen = rows.length > 0 && rows[0].classList.contains("open");

  // Close all
  var all = document.getElementsByClassName("nonStopRow");
  for (var i = 0; i < all.length; i++) {
      all[i].classList.remove("open");
  }

  // Re-open only if it was previously closed
  if (!isOpen) {
      for (var j = 0; j < rows.length; j++) {
          rows[j].classList.add("open");
      }
  }
}

function toggleNonStopsAA(group) {

    // collapse all non-stop rows
    var allRows = document.getElementsByClassName("nonStopRow");

    for (var i = 0; i < allRows.length; i++) {

        // do not hide current station
        if (allRows[i].classList.contains("currentStation"))
            continue;

        allRows[i].style.display = "none";
    }

    // expand selected group
    var grpRows = document.getElementsByClassName(group);

    for (var i = 0; i < grpRows.length; i++) {

        if (grpRows[i].classList.contains("currentStation"))
            continue;

        grpRows[i].style.display = "flex";
    }
}

function toggleNonStops(group) {

    var clickedRows = document.getElementsByClassName(group);
    var allRows = document.getElementsByClassName("nonStopRow");

    // Check current state BEFORE changing anything.
    // Ignore currentStation because it is always visible.
    var isExpanded = false;

    for (var i = 0; i < clickedRows.length; i++) {

        if (clickedRows[i].classList.contains("currentStation")) {
            continue;
        }

        if (window.getComputedStyle(clickedRows[i]).display !== "none") {
            isExpanded = true;
            break;
        }
    }

    // Collapse ALL groups first.
    // Current station must always remain visible.
    for (var i = 0; i < allRows.length; i++) {

        if (allRows[i].classList.contains("currentStation")) {
            allRows[i].style.display = "flex";
        } else {
            allRows[i].style.display = "none";
        }
    }

    // If clicked group was already expanded,
    // leave it collapsed: true toggle behavior.
    if (isExpanded) {
        updateAllArrows(null);
        return;
    }

    // Otherwise expand only clicked group.
    for (var i = 0; i < clickedRows.length; i++) {
        clickedRows[i].style.display = "flex";
    }

    updateAllArrows(group);
}
</script>

    const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('accessibilityToggle');

    const savedHlink = localStorage.getItem('hlink');

      toggleBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
      panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', !isOpen);
    });
    }

    // Outside click to close
    document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (!document.querySelector('.floating-accessibility').contains(e.target)) {
        panel.classList.remove('show');
        toggleBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      }
    });

    // Dark Mode Toggle
    
     if (savedTheme === 'dark' || (!savedTheme && prefersDark)) {
      document.body.classList.add('dark');
      themeToggle.checked = true;

     // document.body.classList.toggle('dark', themeToggle.checked);

      if (themeToggle.checked) {
          document.body.classList.add('dark');
          localStorage.setItem('theme', 'dark');
        } else {
          document.body.classList.remove('dark');
          localStorage.setItem('theme', 'light');
        }
      
    });
     }

    const sbtn = document.getElementById('sBtn');
    if(sbtn!=null){
    sbtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    	setFontSize('small');
        });
    }
    const mbtn = document.getElementById('mBtn');
    if(mbtn!=null){
    mbtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    	setFontSize('medium');
        });
    }
    const lbtn = document.getElementById('lBtn');
    if(lbtn !=null){
    lbtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    	setFontSize('large');
        });
    }
    // Font Size Control
    function setFontSize(size) {
      if (size === 'small') {
        document.body.style.fontSize = '12px';
        sbtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', true);
        mbtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', false);
        lbtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', false);
        localStorage.setItem('fontSize', 'small');
      } else if (size === 'medium') {
        document.body.style.fontSize = '15px';
        sbtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', false);
        mbtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', true);
        lbtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', false);
        localStorage.setItem('fontSize', 'medium');
      } else if (size === 'large') {
        document.body.style.fontSize = '18px';
        sbtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', false);
        mbtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', false);
        lbtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', true);
        localStorage.setItem('fontSize', 'large');
      }
    }

    const btn = document.getElementById('textSpacingBtn');
	if(btn!=null){
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isActive = btn.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true';
      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(!isActive));

      // Toggle text spacing on the body (or target container)
      if (!isActive) {
        document.body.style.letterSpacing = '0.15em';
        localStorage.setItem('tspace', '1');
      } else {
        document.body.style.letterSpacing = '';
        localStorage.setItem('tspace', '0');
      }
    });
	}


    const lineHeightBtn = document.getElementById('lineHeightBtn');
	if(lineHeightBtn !=null){
    lineHeightBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isActive = lineHeightBtn.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true';
      lineHeightBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(!isActive));

      if (!isActive) {
        document.body.style.lineHeight = '1.8'; // Increased line height
        localStorage.setItem('lspace', '1');
      } else {
        document.body.style.lineHeight = ''; // Reset to default
        localStorage.setItem('lspace', '0');
      }
    });
	}

    const invertBtn = document.getElementById('invertColorsBtn');
	if(invertBtn!=null){
    invertBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const isPressed = invertBtn.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true';
      invertBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(!isPressed));

      if (!isPressed) {
        document.body.style.filter = 'invert(1)';
        localStorage.setItem('inv', '1');
      } else {
        document.body.style.filter = '';
        localStorage.setItem('inv', '0');
      }
    });
	}

    const scrBtn = document.getElementById('sReadBtn');
	if(scrBtn!=null){
    scrBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    	window.open("ScreenReader.html", '_blank').focus();
    });
	}

    const crBtn = document.getElementById('curBtn');
	if(crBtn!=null){
	 crBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
	   document.body.classList.toggle('big-cursor');
	   const isPressed = crBtn.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true';
	   crBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', !isPressed);
	   localStorage.setItem('curs', !isPressed?'1':'0');
	 });
	}
	const hLinkBtn = document.getElementById('hLinkBtn');
	if(hLinkBtn!=null){
	hLinkBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
		   document.body.classList.toggle('high-link');
		   const isPressed = hLinkBtn.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true';
		   hLinkBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', !isPressed);
		   localStorage.setItem('hlink', !isPressed?'1':'0');
		 });
	}	 

	  window.onload = function() {
	      const savedFontSize = localStorage.getItem('fontSize') || 'medium';
	      setFontSize(savedFontSize);
	      if(savedTspace==='1'){
	    	  btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed',true);
	    	  document.body.style.letterSpacing = '0.15em';
		      }
	      if(savedLspace==='1'){
	    	  lineHeightBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', true);
	    	  document.body.style.lineHeight = '1.8';
		      }
	      if(savedCurs ==='1'){
	    	  crBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', true);
	    	  document.body.classList.add('big-cursor');
		      }
	      if(savedInv ==='1'){
	    	  invertBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', true);
	    	  document.body.style.filter = 'invert(1)';
		      }
	      if(savedHlink==='1'){
	    	  hLinkBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', true);
	    	  document.body.classList.add('high-link');
		      }
	    };
	 
  </script>

<script>
function updateAllArrows(openGroup) {
    document.querySelectorAll('.stopArrow').forEach(function (arrow) {
        const arrowGroup = arrow.getAttribute('data-group');

        if (openGroup && arrowGroup === openGroup) {
            arrow.classList.remove('fa-chevron-down');
            arrow.classList.add('fa-chevron-up');
        } else {
            arrow.classList.remove('fa-chevron-up');
            arrow.classList.add('fa-chevron-down');
        }
    });
}
</script>
